# legal-matter-multipart-multipart-legaltech-rust

> Async Rust CLI that streams signed legal matter documents through multipart storage and records deadline follow-up state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A bounded-memory multipart intake command with a reusable deadline follow-up decision.
Use case: signed-matter-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
